ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reflective rock fits my recent listening, but I would prioritize blues today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Gary Clark Jr. Live; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Live blues guitar appeals to the interest reflected in People, Hell & Angels.
ItemID: NA; Title: Led Zeppelin IV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-influenced rock fits, but I am more interested in exploring another release today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Duets: Re-Working The Catalogue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of reworked duets is less appealing right now than a focused blues album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ride Out; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented rock sounds relevant, but it would not be my first choice this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Yesterday And Today The U.S. Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a Beatles compilation right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Pop-oriented rock is less aligned with my current interest in blues and roots music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar is appealing, but I would try Gary Clark Jr. Live first.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Old Sock makes this relaxed, Clapton-connected roots record especially appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots and classic-rock connection interests me, but a large live collection feels like too much for this visit.
